subject: general
question: Which committee was constituted for banking sector reforms?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Narsimham Committee**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Narsimham Committee** was constituted for banking sector reforms in India.
 
• The committee was formed under the chairmanship of **M. Narasimham** in 1991 and again in 1998.
 
• It aimed at enhancing the efficiency and productivity of the banking sector.
 
• Key recommendations included measures for **financial sector liberalization, improving the health of financial institutions,** and introducing **prudential norms**.
 
• The committee's recommendations led to significant changes in the Indian banking system, including **reduction in statutory pre-emptions, deregulation of interest rates, and strengthening of banking supervision**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Narasimham Committee I** (1991) focused on the broader aspects of financial sector reforms.
 
• **The Narasimham Committee II** (1998) focused on banking sector reforms to make Indian banks more competitive and efficient.
 
• Some of the major reforms included **reduction in CRR and SLR, introduction of capital adequacy norms,** and **setting up of Asset Reconstruction Companies (ARCs)**.
 
• The recommendations have played a crucial role in the modernization and improvement of the Indian banking sector.
